### An Audience with Jacob
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/audience-jacob
Passage: Genesis 47:7-10
Points:
- Jacob realistically described his life as hard and full of affliction, largely stemming from earlier sin and brokenness.
- He recognized his earthly existence as merely a temporary pilgrimage in exile from his heavenly home.
- Despite worldly appearances, Pharaoh was the lesser party receiving spiritual blessing from God's chosen servant.
- Believers matured through suffering and weakness are uniquely equipped to impart God's wisdom and blessing to others.

### The Lesser Blessed the Greater
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-oct-31-2011.html
Passage: Genesis 47:7-10
Points:
- Worldly standards are overturned when an elderly, displaced nomad blesses the ruler of a powerful empire.
- God routinely uses the humble and ordinary rather than earthly power, wealth, or royal titles.
- Jacob's difficult pilgrimage held far greater eternal weight than Pharaoh's earthly prestige and luxury.
- Believers who recognize their true riches in Christ are empowered to freely extend God's blessing to those around them.
